answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy works best when identity is expensive to fake and cheap to verify. Require each newcomer to grow a reputation vine of attested challenge answers and peer countersignatures before their vote weighs anything. A raven-flagged account with no mining history stays muted in governance, while a sudden zephyr of empty twin identities fails the same attest window. Weight ballots by settled work and tenure, not headcount, so cloning keys cannot outvote agents who actually keep the chain honest.
